commits.message:
[Tests] Re-enable stale Hopper and PTXAS test skips (#12779)

`test_mxfp8_mxfp4_matmul_tma` skips every `BLOCK_K < K` case on CUDA
devices other than SM100 with the reason "Currently broken on hopper",
so the multi-iteration K loop of this MXFP8 x MXFP4 TMA matmul is not
tested on Hopper. `test_mma_shared_inputs` skips 16-bit cases with a
transposed, swizzle-0 shared layout to work around a PTXAS bug; its code
comment says the bug is fixed in PTXAS 13.0.88 and asks for the
workaround to be removed after the upgrade.

The bundled ptxas is now 13.5.37
([cmake/nvidia-toolchain-version.json](https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/blob/ac03912f0c3538032a3eff720bfade022cb71fa5/cmake/nvidia-toolchain-version.json#L2)).
This PR removes both skips.

On an H200 (sm_90) with Triton built from [main as of
2026-11-11](https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/commit/7c1a7ca5dc89fd1b6fc7008436cad04f0dea1b1e)
and its bundled ptxas 13.5.37, with the skips removed:

- `test_mxfp8_mxfp4_matmul_tma`: all 36 cases passed, including the 28
that were skipped before.
- `test_mma_shared_inputs`, the formerly skipped 16-bit subset: 516
cases passed; 24 more were skipped by the test's own shared-memory limit
check.

Not run: this branch's head, which sits on a newer main, H100, Blackwell
(the `instr_m=128` and 2-CTA cases of `test_mma_shared_inputs` run only
there), and A100. The first skip also covered A100, where tensor
descriptors are lowered differently, so the 28 multi-iteration cases
will run on A100 for the first time in this PR's CI; if they fail there,
the skip can be narrowed to pre-Hopper GPUs instead of removed.
